DuniaKu v2 uses Phaser 4.2.1 (Giedi), an MIT-licensed 2D HTML5 game framework.
Official release: https://phaser.io/download/release/v4.2.1
CDN file used and cached by the PWA service worker:
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/phaser@4.2.1/dist/phaser.min.js

Phaser itself is not modified by DuniaKu. The app's engine-games.js contains DuniaKu-specific game logic and vector artwork.
